newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: WAREHOUSE Q4 SALES NZ$151 MLN, UP 22.8 PCT.
newsitem.headline: WAREHOUSE Q4 SALES NZ$151 MLN, UP 22.8 PCT.

text.p: Discount retailer The Warehouse said on Friday sales in the July quarter were NZ$151 million, up 22.8 percent in gross terms on the same period last year.
Same store sales rose 16 percent in the quarter, though amid a number of moves to clear stocks and cut prices, while for the 12 months to the end of July they were up 7.2 percent.
Total sales for the year were NZ$647 million.
"This is $93 million, or 16.8 percent, above that for the corresponding 12 months ended July 1996," the company said in a statement.
For the six months ended July, sales of $286 million were achieved, up 19.2 percent or $46 million on sales for the same period last year.
The company noted that sales achieved in the last quarter included both the seasonal clearance of winter merchandise and markdown action taken on range rationalisation.
The company said it would announce its full-year result on or before Ocotber 14.
